paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构学习小组收到“缩短阅读清单”的请求，先发现尚未明确是减少篇数还是减少总阅读时间。有人在指导下整理问题，有人按检查点负责说明，也有人协助说明的作者；这些参与方式都不能证明所选删减正确。例子可停在澄清请求，不要求为了表现独立而自行删改他人的工作。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional study group is asked to shorten a reading list without knowing whether that means fewer entries or less total reading time. Someone structures the question with guidance, owns the brief with checkpoints or supports its author. None establishes that a proposed cut is correct. Clarifying the request is enough, without independently changing someone else’s work to demonstrate independence.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只看虚构请求，目标、已知信息和待确认问题分别是什么？谁负责确认解释？”可以只讨论，不提供真实绩效实例。听者区分任务责任与是否需要帮助，不从某类较多推断聪明、自信或职业高低；原有练习的条数只是可调整示例，不是完成要求。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates the fictional request’s purpose, known information and unanswered question, asking who confirms the interpretation. Discussion needs no real performance example. A listener separates responsibility from support needs without inferring intelligence, confidence or career rank from counts. Existing exercise counts are adaptable examples, not completion requirements.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读；原有小练习同样可跳过，次数不作为训练剂量或效果证据。沿用同一当前或近期角色及近12周，每题只选一个具体实例，有多个时用最近一次。十二题分三组各四题，指导、按检查点承担、支持他人和未评估为四种不排序的类别；每组四类计数合计4，逐题标签保留，不算分数、均值、胜出角色或职业等级。没有实例、无法区分及保留回答独立记为未评估，不代表能力不足；支持他人也不等于专家或最终决定者。相同数量可来自不同任务，不比较表现、成长或练习效果。OPM与USA Staffing只提供概念背景，本原创方法不是其题本或评分量表，尚无已建立的信效度、常模、职业校准或英中文测量等值。讨论可全用虚构材料，不上传工作文件，不用于招聘、晋升或权限判断。三份公开全文始终可读；原有默认页面内存、明确选择的24小时标签页草稿及完成退出重测清除保持不变，复制仅含公开标题和入口。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading. Existing exercises can also be skipped; counts are neither training doses nor evidence of benefit. Keep one current or recent role and the past twelve weeks, choosing one concrete instance per task, the most recent if several apply. Twelve tasks form three groups of four. Guided, owned with checkpoints, supported and non-assessment are unordered categories. Each group’s four category counts sum to four, with individual labels retained and no score, mean, winning role or career tier. No instance, unclear distinctions and withheld answers remain non-assessment, not low ability. Supporting someone establishes neither expertise nor final authority. Equal counts may involve different tasks and establish no performance, growth or practice effect. OPM and USA Staffing supply conceptual background; this original method is neither their instrument nor rating scale and lacks established reliability, validity, norms, career calibration or English–Chinese measurement equivalence. Discussion can stay fictional without work uploads, hiring, promotion or authority decisions. All three public full guides remain open. Existing default page memory, explicitly chosen 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged. Copying includes only the public title and entry.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构活动说明已制作完成，但提供的开放时间发生变化。编写者可以仍负责自己的产出，同时请有权确认时间的人复核；复核者提供支持，不因此取得发布决定权。文件存在、要求达成和发布获准分别核对，不把“承担任务”的类别当作交付正确或可跳过检查的证明。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional event sheet is finished when its supplied opening times change. Its author can own the output while the authorized person checks the new hours; a reviewer supports the author without acquiring publication authority. An existing file, met requirements and permission to publish need separate checks. An owned-task category proves no correct delivery or exemption from review.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只为虚构产出区分已核实要求、尚未核实内容及谁能确认调整；什么情况需要暂停交付？”可以保留未知或不演练。听者不奖励取消复核、默默猜测或超量承诺；真实任务仍按既有要求处理，练习不授予改动或发布权限。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates verified requirements, unchecked details and who can confirm a change in the fictional output, asking when delivery should pause. Unknowns or no rehearsal are acceptable. A listener rewards no removed review, silent guesses or overpromising. Actual work follows its own requirements; the exercise grants no permission to change or publish.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构协作者为一份说明补充了一条术语解释，文件仍由原作者负责。补充内容可能有帮助，也可能需要作者澄清适用范围；支持的类别本身不认证专业水平。有人不方便参加讨论时，可保留原安排，不用会议参与度、声音大小或额外接活判断贡献。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional collaborator adds one term explanation to a note that remains its author’s responsibility. The addition may help or need its scope clarified; a supported-task category certifies no expertise. If someone cannot join a discussion, the existing arrangement can remain. Meeting attendance, loudness or extra work establish no contribution.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只看虚构说明，谁负责产出、谁提供协助、接收者仍需知道什么？”可以不邀请他人或只读例子。听者不接管别人的责任、不把拒绝额外工作当作不合作，也不把沉默当成说明有效的证明；反馈由愿意且有条件参与的人提供。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks who owns the fictional output, who helps and what its recipient still needs to know. Reading alone needs no invitation. A listener takes over no responsibility, calls no declined extra work uncooperative and treats no silence as proof of usefulness. Feedback depends on willing, available participation.
